entities.summary: Francesco Illy was a Hungarian-born accountant, bookkeeper, businessman and philanthropist, best known for founding Illy and inventing various coffee-related machinery. Born in Temesvár, in the Banat region of the Austro-Hungarian Empire, he later became a naturalized Italian citizen while retaining his Hungarian nationality.
